lines.en: Swimming, scales shimmering.

lines.en: Kumonryu glides through the water.

lines.en: Body twists, dancing in water.
Moves slowly along the riverbed.
Tail swaying, elegant swim.

lines.zh: 鳞片在水中闪烁，如宝石般。
lines.en: Scales shimmer like gems in water.
Kumonryu swims, vigilant around.
Swimming gracefully in water.
Frolics lightly in water.

lines.zh: 它绕过樱树落下的花瓣。
lines.en: It skirts the petals drifting from the blossom trees.
Floats quietly in water.

lines.zh: 九文龙一动不动地游着。
lines.en: Kumonryu swims motionless.
Rests quietly in water.

lines.en: Floats on water surface, leisurely.

lines.en: It hangs motionless among the water weeds.

lines.zh: 白纹在墨鳞上一明一暗。
lines.en: White markings flicker over its ink-dark scales.
It keeps watch over this stretch of blossom-wood water.

lines.zh: 水下十六格的怪物都躲着它。
lines.en: Monsters within sixteen blocks keep clear of it.

lines.zh: 它吞吐水泡，纹路随之晃动。
lines.en: It blows a bubble and its pattern ripples.

lines.zh: 我背上的墨纹正在游动。
lines.en: The ink pattern on my back is swimming.

Takes notice of player, vigilant.
Glances towards player.

lines.en: My ink pattern circles once; I halt before you.
Seeks player, waiting for opportunity.

lines.zh: 注意到了玩家，紧张起来。
lines.en: Detects player, gets tense.

lines.zh: 墨纹转了半圈，我盯住你。
lines.en: My ink patterns turn halfway round as I fix on you.
Takes notice of player, vigilant.
Stares at player, ready to strike.
It rises to the surface for a look at you.

lines.zh: 墨鳞上那道白纹对着你。
lines.en: The white stripe on its black scales faces you.
It circles your reflection, sizing it up.
It spies on you from beneath the petals.
It turns, sweeping its scales' shine across you.

lines.zh: 看你一眼，它又潜入深处。
lines.en: One look at you, then it sinks away.

lines.zh: 它把你的影子当成入侵者。
lines.en: It takes your shadow for an intruder.
It circles twice by your feet.
My scales hurt!
I got scratched!
Stop touching me!
I'm hurt, go away!

lines.zh: 墨纹渗出血，把池水弄浑。
lines.en: Blood through my ink marks clouds the pond.

lines.zh: 墨色鳞片被削掉了一块。
lines.en: A shard of my ink-dark scales is gone.
Stop attacking me!
I'm dying!
Stop hitting me!

lines.zh: 鱼饵在我嘴边跳动，我却未动一鳍！
lines.en: Bait dances near my mouth, yet I remain still.
Your tasty morsel isn't worth a glance.

lines.zh: 水中的美味不是给你的！
lines.en: My prey in water isn't for you.

lines.zh: 这美食留给你那愚蠢的猎物吧！
lines.en: Let that foolish prey feast on it.
Not me, your prey.
No interest in your bait.
Come and take your prey.
Bait, I don't eat it.

lines.zh: 那是什么美味？我却不吃！
lines.en: What delicacy is that? Not for me.

lines.zh: 不要让我看到你们的猎物！
lines.en: Do not let me see your prey.
Do not touch me, I will retaliate.
You'll regret the collision.

lines.zh: 我的身体不是用来碰撞的！
lines.en: My body isn't for collision.
Collision with me means defeat.

lines.zh: 你的靴尖碰到我的墨鳞。
lines.en: Your boot tip brushed my ink scales.
Stay away, or you'll get beat up.
I'm not one to mess with.
Come near, and you'll learn a lesson.
Don't touch me, or I'll punch you.
My body is off limits.
Here, I am your mate.
I am willing to be your mate.
Do you want my offspring?

My eggs are your choice.

lines.zh: 池底的卵床，我已经清好了。
lines.en: I've cleared the spawning bed at the pond bottom.
My eggs bring new life.
After mating, you will gain strength.
We mate and pass on.
Gurgle, I'm the Kumonryu!

lines.zh: 看我的鳞片，你害怕了吗？
lines.en: Look at my scales, are you scared now?
I don't eat dead meat, only live prey!
Stay away from my territory, or else…

lines.zh: 你的鱼饵是诱饵，我会咬钩！
lines.en: Your bait is a lure, I'll bite the hook!

lines.zh: 我是水面下的守护者，敬畏我吧！
lines.en: I'm the guardian beneath the surface, fear me!
Fishes, let's dance together!

lines.zh: 这附近没有我的同类，孤独吗？
lines.en: There's no one like me nearby, lonely?

lines.zh: 我是九文龙，你听我的声音！
lines.en: I'm Kumonryu, listen to my voice!

lines.zh: 我的鳞片反射阳光，闪亮！
lines.en: My scales reflect sunlight, they shine!
Prey, prey, it's here!

lines.zh: 我要品尝你的味道，鱼肉！
lines.en: I'm going to taste your fishy flavor!

lines.zh: 我的眼睛追踪你，你逃不掉！
lines.en: My eyes track you, you can't escape!

lines.zh: 你在这片水域中是透明的！
lines.en: You're transparent in this water!

lines.zh: 我就是死亡的象征，你闻到了吗？
lines.en: I'm the symbol of death, can you smell it?

lines.zh: 猎物的味道越来越近了，抓住它！
lines.en: The prey's scent is getting closer, catch it!

lines.zh: 你跑不掉的，我会追上你的！
lines.en: You can't escape, I'll catch you!

lines.zh: 你在这片水域中是唯一的猎物！
lines.en: You're the only prey in this water!

lines.zh: 我的体型大，你躲不过我！
lines.en: My size is big, you can't avoid me!

lines.zh: 我的速度很快，你追不上我！
lines.en: I'm fast, you can't catch me!
You stepped into the water and startled it.

lines.zh: 樱林水域不许外人久留。
lines.en: Outsiders are not welcome long in blossom waters.

lines.zh: 它察觉水里多了一个影子。
lines.en: It senses one more shadow in the water.
A monster nears, and it turns first.
You have muddied its territory.

lines.zh: 水波一乱，它便锁定了你。
lines.en: The ripples break, and it fixes on you.
Ink-marked tail, charging at you.
Your end has come, fishy!

lines.zh: 看我的攻击，你承受不起！
lines.en: Look at my attack, you can't handle it!

lines.zh: 这是我的地盘，你逃不掉！
lines.en: This is my territory, you can't escape!
My attack makes you tremble!

lines.zh: 九纹在水里游成一条黑线。
lines.en: My nine bands swim into one black line.

lines.zh: 我的攻击是致命的，快闪开！
lines.en: My attack is lethal, get out of the way!

lines.zh: 我的攻击如同闪电，你无法躲避！
lines.en: My attack is like lightning, you can't dodge!

lines.zh: 你的生命将在我的攻击下结束！
lines.en: Your life will end under my attack!

lines.zh: 我的攻击是死亡的象征！
lines.en: My attack is the symbol of death!
